name: Etsy Shop
description: Reference front-end implementation of an Etsy shop in Drupal: an 'Etsy listing' content type with ~40 fields, section/materials taxonomies, image styles, a listings view and templates, populated on cron from the Etsy API. Submodule of Etsy API.

suggests.pathauto: Optional URL alias pattern for Etsy listing nodes (config/optional).
suggests.metatag: Optional metatag defaults for Etsy listing nodes (config/optional).

project_description: Etsy Shop is a submodule of the Etsy API project and serves as the base/example implementation of an Etsy shop in Drupal. On install it creates an 'Etsy listing' content type with roughly forty Etsy fields (price, images, dimensions, personalization, timestamps, ids, etc.), an 'Etsy section' and 'Etsy materials' taxonomy, several Etsy image styles, an Etsy Shop view, a custom view mode and node templates. On each cron run it uses the etsy.api service to import shop sections into taxonomy terms and shop listings into etsy_listing nodes (creating, updating and deleting nodes to mirror the shop). It depends on etsy, views, node and taxonomy; Pathauto and Metatag are optional. No checkout/ecommerce is included, per the Etsy API terms of service.
